findings.text: the sentence 'Each statement was checked with EXPLAIN against the live graph' is not backed by any record: no run-dir log contains EXPLAIN and no worker-stream tool call ran it. The statements were executed for real (apply.log, EXIT=0), which subsumes EXPLAIN's parse check, so no residual risk remains, but the fragment asserts an evidence check the run did not perform.

the figure caption says 'ten domains take one each' but only eight target domains take a single bar (fast_particles and gyrokinetics take two each); the caption's own arithmetic, 6+4+3+10=23, contradicts the 25 the same paragraph states. figure-render.log repeats the miscount ('ten 1s'), so record and figure agree on a wrong number.

the citation 'the build's path upsert applies at build_dd.py:3583' points at a docstring line of _batch_create_path_nodes in the landed revision; the domain_source IS NULL guard is at build_dd.py:3679 at head (3584 at the 854e3980e base), so the line number is stale for the revision it landed at.
